AdjustmentRequest.description: A privileged correction in one currency; entries must sum to zero.
AdjustmentRequest.title: AdjustmentRequest

BaseAmountResponse.description: A labelled snapshot in the plan's base currency; never rewrites postings.
BaseAmountResponse.title: BaseAmountResponse

BudgetCreateRequest.description: A limit in the plan's base currency; ``daily`` applies to every day.
BudgetCreateRequest.title: BudgetCreateRequest

estimated_rates.description: Some totals use offline estimated rates
estimated_rates.title: Estimated Rates

ChangeItem.description:
One entity state to apply. ``seq`` is null for snapshot rows.

``data`` is the entity's public representation (the same contract the REST
resource returns) and is null for ``delete``. Apply an upsert only when
``version`` is at least the locally stored version. A delete carries the
version at which the row disappeared and beats every upsert with a version
not greater than it; an upsert with a greater version revives the entity
(a membership that was left and joined again).
ChangeItem.title: ChangeItem

CommitmentCreateRequest.description: A planned cost; link it from the expense that pays it to count it once.
CommitmentCreateRequest.title: CommitmentCreateRequest

token.description: Shown once. Share it inside the invite link; never log it.
token.title: Token

EmailVerifyRequest.description: Either ``challenge_id`` + ``code`` from the email, or the magic-link ``link_token``.
EmailVerifyRequest.title: EmailVerifyRequest

base_rate.description: Rate to the plan's base currency, for budgets and display only

commitment_id.description: The planned cost this expense pays for; it then counts once, as actual
commitment_id.title: Commitment Id

ExpenseRequest.description: A full expense value: creating it or replacing it appends a revision.

base_rate.description: Rate to the plan's base currency, for budgets and display only

commitment_id.description: The planned cost this expense pays for; it then counts once, as actual
commitment_id.title: Commitment Id

ExpenseRequest.title: ExpenseRequest

ExternalSignInRequest.description:
Google/Apple ID token. With a guest bearer token this upgrades or claims the guest;
with a registered bearer token it re-authenticates (step-up) the current session.
ExternalSignInRequest.title: ExternalSignInRequest

notice.default: Beluno records what participants pooled with a custodian; it never holds, moves, or stores money.
notice.title: Notice

InvitePreviewResponse.description: Deliberately minimal: no members, balances, bookings, or locations.
InvitePreviewResponse.title: InvitePreviewResponse

balance_minor.description: Positive: should receive money; negative: owes
balance_minor.title: Balance Minor

LedgerResponse.description: The plan's balances per participant and currency, never netted across currencies.

fund.description: Money the participants recorded as pooled; Beluno holds and moves none
fund.title: Fund

LedgerResponse.title: LedgerResponse

PaidAmount.description: What actually changed hands when it was another currency than the debt.
PaidAmount.title: PaidAmount

rate.description: Paid-currency units per debt-currency unit the amounts imply
rate.title: Rate

ParticipantSeed.description:
A registered person (``user_id``) or a name-only placeholder.

``id`` is an optional client-generated participant ID; it is ignored when the
person already has a participant row in the plan (that row is reused).
ParticipantSeed.title: ParticipantSeed

PayerRequest.description: A participant who paid, or the plan fund (``fund: true``).
PayerRequest.title: PayerRequest

basis_points.description: Hundredths of a percent; all shares total 10000
basis_points.title: Basis Points

PlanDuplicateRequest.description:
Copies only the allowlisted structure; see the ``plan-copy-v1`` manifest.

Omit ``group_id`` to keep the source group; send ``null`` for no group.
``participant_ids`` omitted copies every active registered participant;
an empty list copies none.
PlanDuplicateRequest.title: PlanDuplicateRequest

PlanTiming.description:
``undecided``; ``date`` (start_date, optional end_date); or ``datetime``
(starts_at with offset, optional ends_at, IANA timezone).
PlanTiming.title: PlanTiming

PlanUpdateRequest.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged; ``null`` clears description or location.
PlanUpdateRequest.title: PlanUpdateRequest

PublicProblemResponse.description: Typed-client-safe problem fields guaranteed across every API error.
PublicProblemResponse.title: PublicProblemResponse

PushOperation.description: One queued client mutation. ``operation_id`` doubles as its idempotency key.
PushOperation.title: PushOperation

PushProblem.description: Why an operation did not apply; mirrors the REST problem fields.
PushProblem.title: PushProblem

PushResult.description:
``applied``/``replayed`` carry the command's response; ``conflict``,
``rejected`` and ``upgrade_required`` are permanent for this payload; ``retry``
is transient; ``skipped`` means an ordering or dependency requirement failed and
the operation was not attempted.
PushResult.title: PushResult

RateRequest.description: Quote-currency units for one unit of the expense currency (major units).
RateRequest.title: RateRequest

display_name.description: Required when joining as a guest without an account.
display_name.title: Display Name

plan.description: Present once access is active (not while pending approval).

session.description: Guest session created for a caller without an account.

RefundRequest.description: Money that came back; by default it follows the current owed shares.
RefundRequest.title: RefundRequest

ScopeEntry.description: One scope the caller may sync right now.
ScopeEntry.title: ScopeEntry

SeriesCreateRequest.description:
A recurring plan. ``recurrence_rule`` is an RRULE subset, e.g.
``FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TH`` or ``FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1FR;COUNT=6``.
SeriesCreateRequest.title: SeriesCreateRequest

SeriesSplitRequest.description: Change this and future occurrences from ``from_date``; earlier ones stay as they are.
SeriesSplitRequest.title: SeriesSplitRequest

SettlementPreviewResponse.description: A suggestion only: nothing is recorded until someone records a settlement.
SettlementPreviewResponse.title: SettlementPreviewResponse

SettlementRequest.description: ``from`` paid ``to``: the payer's balance rises and the receiver's falls.

fee_minor.description: Bank or transfer fee the payer bore; not part of the debt
fee_minor.title: Fee Minor

SettlementRequest.title: SettlementRequest

SplitExtra.description: Tax, tip, or a service charge, spread over the item subtotals.
SplitExtra.title: SplitExtra

SplitItem.description: One bill line, split equally among its participants or by ``weights``.
SplitItem.title: SplitItem

refresh_token.description: Present when a new session starts or rotates; absent after step-up.
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

TransactionResponse.description: One balanced journal entry; its postings sum to zero in each currency.
TransactionResponse.title: TransactionResponse

TravelSegmentRequest.description:
Local wall-clock times with IANA zones (flights cross zones), or dates only.

``id`` is an optional client-generated ID for a new segment; updates ignore it.
TravelSegmentRequest.title: TravelSegmentRequest

UnconvertedSpend.description: Spend or planned cost in another currency without a rate; not in the totals.
UnconvertedSpend.title: UnconvertedSpend

WaiverRequest.description: The creditor forgives part of what the debtor owes; no money changes hands.
WaiverRequest.title: WaiverRequest

info.description: API for plans with your people.
info.title: Beluno API

Apply a page and store its cursor in one local transaction; keep the old
cursor if applying fails. ``resync_required`` means the cursor predates the
retention floor, a restore, or an access change: pull again with a null cursor.

post.description:
Apply queued operations in order; every operation gets its own result.

Keep retrying ``retry`` and ``skipped`` operations unchanged with the same
``operation_id``; drop or revise ``rejected``, ``conflict`` and
``upgrade_required`` ones. Replays of applied operations are free.
